title: Implement workload-aware prewarming with hysteresis and oscillation-free eviction
goal: model_preload provides isolated frequency/recency scoring over in-memory events; lacks integration with idle/pressure memory eviction, hysteresis damping against load/evict oscillation, and mixed-workload benchmark measuring cold starts. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
